page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.32-256 is an Arm-based cloud virtual machine tailored for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The configuration is powered by Ampere Altra processors running at a sustained clock speed of 3.0 GHz on the arm64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated physical cores matching 32 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core design without simultaneous multithreading. This hardware approach ensures deterministic compute behavior without resource contention across thread pairs.

System memory is sized at 256 GB, establishing an 8 GB per core allocation. This 1:8 core-to-memory ratio places the instance firmly in the memory-optimized bracket. The server includes no local NVMe storage, meaning all persistent storage operations rely on network-attached block volumes. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address and features zero hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the Ampere Altra platform delivers a dense footprint of predictable physical cores and high memory capacity at lower power and hardware overhead than conventional x86 architectures. Workloads requiring substantial memory capacity benefit from consistent processing performance per core, though environments requiring local high-IOPS ephemeral scratch space must account for the absence of onboard disks.

VM.Standard.A1.Flex.32-256 is suitable for large in-memory databases, memory-resident caches, distributed data processing frameworks, containerized microservices fleets, and enterprise Arm compilation environments.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.32-256 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by 32 dedicated Ampere Altra physical cores built on the 64-bit Arm architecture. Operating at a steady 3.0 GHz with a single thread per core, the system provides 32 vCPUs without the cross-thread contention found in simultaneous multithreading designs. Accompanied by 256 GB of system RAM, it maintains an elevated 8 GB per core memory profile. The instance includes no onboard local storage, depending on remote block storage solutions for disk operations, and operates without discrete GPUs. With one complimentary public IPv4 address provided, this instance delivers consistent execution predictability and expansive memory density. It is specifically suited for memory-centric enterprise workloads, including in-memory databases, Redis caches, high-density container platforms, and parallel compilation pipelines that do not require local ephemeral NVMe drives.
